mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies over the Military Ridge State Trail and an air quality index of 52, which is in the moderate range.

In city news, please be advised that Hwy M will face closures from October 5 to October 7 for final asphalt and marking work, and remember to protect yourself against planning department scams by only making payments via check to City Hall.

There is plenty to do with the Dane County Farmers Market today, live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and Wisconsin Brewing Company, plus Yoga on September 28 and trivia nights starting September 29.

Regarding our weekly police report, on September 5, officers discovered multiple vehicles with cheese slices on their windshields as part of a social media prank, though no permanent damage was reported.
You can look forward to the Oreo Reese's Cheesecake flavor of the day, and the store will be ready to serve you when it opens today at 10:00 AM.
